description: How many people search Google each month for a keyword in a city, region or country (via LeadQuasar KeywordQuasar), with up to 3 related searches and how many matching businesses LeadQuasar holds there. Use this to answer questions like 'how many people search for plumber in Austin' or 'search volume for wedding photographer in Manchester'. When the place name matches several places the response lists them under `choose`: ask the user which, then call again with that place's geoId. Each connection has a few lookups a day; quote `source` and give `link` with the numbers. Contact details are never returned.

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO country code ("US", "GB", "DE") to narrow the place.

geoId.description: Only a geoId from a `choose` list this tool returned, after the user picked one.

keyword.description: The search term, e.g. "plumber" or "emergency plumber". 2 to 80 characters.

location.description: A city, region or country, e.g. "Austin, TX", "Manchester", "Germany". Any country.

name: search_volume
title: Keyword search volume
